en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 9.12.
Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika (The Great Intermediate Dyads, The Wholesome Triplet)
Dependent on a non-wholesome state with an internal object … dependent on a non-wholesome state with a different object … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine;
under the object condition, three; under the predominance condition, five … mutual condition, six … prenascence and repetition conditions, one … non-disappearance condition, nine.
Dependent on a non-mental non-wholesome state … dependent on a non-non-mental non-wholesome state … (Abbreviated.)
Dependent on a state that is neither mental concomitant nor wholesome … (Abbreviated.
Nine in the case of root … pe … five in the case of prenascence and repetition … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither associated with consciousness nor wholesome … (Abbreviated.)

With respect to root-condition: nine; object-condition: three; predominance-condition: five …pe… mutuality-condition: six …pe… prenascence and repetition-conditions: one …pe… non-disappearance-condition: nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither associated with consciousness nor wholesome … (Abbreviated.

With respect to root-condition: nine; object-condition: three; predominance-condition: five …pe… mutuality-condition: six …pe… prenascence and repetition-conditions: one …pe… non-disappearance-condition: nine.
Dependent on a non-mental-originated non-wholesome state ... (Abbreviated.
Nine in the case of root, nine in the case of object, five in the case of predominance ... pe ... five in the cases of prenascence and repetition ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-mental-concomitant non-wholesome state ... (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, there are nine; ... [and so on] ... with respect to the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are five;

... [and so on] ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, there are nine. Dependent on a state that is neither concomitant with mind nor wholesome ... [and so on] ... dependent on a state that is neither conjoined with nor produced by mind and is not wholesome ... [and so on] ...
dependent on a state that is neither conjoined with nor produced by mind, is coexistent with mind, and is not wholesome ... [and so on].
… pe … dependent on a non-wholesome state that is not conjoined with mind, not originated by mind, and does not follow upon mind … (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are nine … pe … under prenascence and repetition conditions there are five … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are nine.
Dependent on a non-internal non-wholesome state … pe … dependent on a non-external non-wholesome state … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are nine; in the object condition, five; in the predominance condition, five … [and so on] … in the non-disappearance condition, nine.
Dependent on a state that is not derived and unwholesome … [abbreviated].

In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, three; in the predominance condition, three … [and so on] … in the prenascence and repetition conditions, one … [and so on] … in the non-disappearance condition, five.
Dependent on a state that is neither-acquired-nor-unwholesome … (Abbreviated.

Under root-condition there are five; under object-condition there are two; under predominance-condition there is one … pe … under repetition-condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are five.
